=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text col ":"
text most "the number in 1..20000 with the most proper divisors: "
text has " has "
text pd " proper divisors\n"
note nd n counts the proper divisors of n, for n up to 20000
global nd ulong 20001
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn main to int
note proper divisors of 1..10 by trial over 1..n-1
for i ulong 10
n = add i 1
emitu n
emit col
for j ulong i
d = add j 1
if eq rem n d 0
emit sp
emitu d
end
end
emit nl
end
note each d counts once for each multiple 2d, 3d, ... up to 20000; fewer than 20000 multiples per d
d = ulong 1
while le d 10000 bound 10000
j = mul d 2
while le j 20000 bound 20000
put nd j add get nd j 1
j = add j d
end
d = add d 1
end
b = ulong 1
for i ulong 20000
n = add i 1
if gt get nd n get nd b
b = n
end
end
emit most
emitu b
emit has
emitu get nd b
emit pd
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
1:
2: 1
3: 1
4: 1 2
5: 1
6: 1 2 3
7: 1
8: 1 2 4
9: 1 3
10: 1 2 5
the number in 1..20000 with the most proper divisors: 15120 has 79 proper divisors
</pre>
